topic: Responsive Design, Accessibility, and Inclusive UX
learningObjectives: Apply responsive design principles across different screen sizes.
Identify accessibility barriers in common interface patterns.
Design inclusive interactions that support diverse user needs.

content.concept: Responsive design adapts layout, content, and interactions to different screen sizes and device contexts.

content.concept: Accessibility barriers can involve contrast, keyboard access, labels, focus states, text size, motion, and interaction complexity.
